issues.explanation: The diff contains no tests/ files, so none of the new behavior (models, policies, middleware dispatch, pick, onboarding, dashboard, switcher) ships with Pest/PHPUnit coverage.
submit() validates input but never calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class), violating the mandatory Livewire rule to authorize every action server-side.
Authorization is enforced with manual membershipFor() null checks plus abort(403) instead of going through the registered Entity/EntityMembership policies via Gate/$this->authorize().
Entity creation plus owner membership is written directly in the Livewire component transaction instead of going through an app/Actions/* use-case class as the conventions require for domain writes.
With exactly one membership whose entity is soft-deleted, $membership->entity is null and the subsequent ->id access fails instead of handling the missing entity.
No CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] is included despite the conventions requiring one for the change.
The entities() relation docblock claims BelongsToMany<User> when the related model is Entity.

conventions.evidence: Follows #[Validate], $fillable, generated-style reversible migrations, docs/database-schema.md update; deviates: no tests, submit() has no $this->authorize (CreateEntity.php:198), manual membershipFor()+abort(403) instead of policies (EntityPickController.php:20, Dashboard.php:296), domain write inline rather than app/Actions/*, no CHANGELOG

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/*.php, app/Models/*.php, app/Policies/*.php: small focused methods, clear names, consistent with sibling style; only nit is User.php:470 BelongsToMany<User> docblock on entities()

requirements.evidence: Entity.php:33-36 getRouteKeyName=slug with entities_slug_unique migration; owner_seq stored generated column plus entity_memberships_one_owner unique index (migration line 828/831); CreateEntity.php:206-236 retry loop calling uniqueSlug() every attempt with base then base-2 suffix; EntityPickController.php:20-24 403 before session write; Dashboard.php:296 403 for non-members; switcher.blade.php is-fullwidth is-link/data-current=1 vs is-fullwidth is-light; routes onboarding/switcher/pick/dashboard plus current_entity alias

scope.evidence: Every file (models, UserRole, policies, middleware, controllers, Livewire components, migrations, factories, lang ui.switch_entity/onboarding texts, switcher/dashboard/onboarding views, navbar link, database-schema.md, routes) serves the task; no members/settings pages, locale middleware, dropdown redesign, or card-centering changes

security.evidence: #[Validate('required|string|max:255')] plus $this->validate() (CreateEntity.php:195-200); 403 checks before writes (EntityPickController.php:20, ResolveCurrentEntity.php:132, Dashboard.php:296); {{ }} escaping in switcher/dashboard blades; deliberate $fillable; gap: submit() lacks $this->authorize though guarded by auth+verified and create policy always true

simplicity.evidence: Reuses default-page layout and x-form-field/x-button components; minor excess: HomeController.php:75-95 duplicates the 0/1/>1 dispatch in ResolveCurrentEntity.php:142-159, and setContext() triple-writes request attributes plus app instance plus CurrentEntity (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:162-170)

tests.evidence: change.diff lists no tests/ or Pest files; all requirements (dispatch matrix, pick 403/audit, onboarding retry/owner/audit, dashboard 403, switcher markup, policies) have zero shown coverage, and the diff is truncated mid-routes/web.php so any post-routes files could not be verified

review.summary: The change implements the full entity data model, policies, tenant-session dispatch, onboarding with slug retry, switcher, dashboard, and docs correctly. It is held to needs-changes because it ships with no tests and the Livewire onboarding action never authorizes server-side, with authorization otherwise done via manual checks rather than the registered policies.
